title: unified-rollouts-probing-staged-shadow-canary-autorollback-workflows
author: Miguel Rivera
description: Motivation: we need safer progressive rollouts for model variants across staged shadow, probing canary and weighted canary phases with automated rollback on composite metric regressions. This PR implements probing/staged-shadow workflows and extends the autorollback engine to support multi-metric thresholds, delayed probe windows, and a lightweight probing sampler that can be enabled per-rollout. Summary of changes: 1) rollout controller: add staged shadow lifecycle states (probe, verify, promote, rollback) and transition guards; 2) probing sampler: configurable sampler that emits probe traffic to candidate model variants and collects latency/error/quality metrics; 3) autorollback engine: support composite metrics and weighted decision functions, add grace windows and hysteresis to avoid flapping; 4) observability: new rollout-level metrics (probe_success_rate, probe_latency_p95, model_quality_delta) and event tracing hooks for each transition; 5) e2e and unit tests: rollout simulation harness updates plus integration tests for probe/verify transitions; 6) docs/quickstarts: rollout YAML examples for staging, canary, A/B and staged-shadow workflows. Implementation notes: the rollout controller uses an explicit probe window where sampled requests are shadowed to candidate variants and evaluated by the probe evaluator. The evaluator computes per-request quality signals using optional golden prompt sets and model scoring callbacks; these signals are aggregated into composite metrics. The autorollback engine now supports rules such as "rollback if composite_quality_drop > X AND error_rate_increase > Y within window W" and includes a configurable stabilization period before final rollback to allow backpressure to settle. Backwards compatibility: existing rollout specs are accepted; new fields are optional and default to current behavior. Testing: ran unit tests, rollout-sim integration tests, and a staged cluster e2e with a synthetic traffic generator. CI: all checks passed after a flaky e2e rerun. Rollout plan: staged rollout in infra canary, followed by a 24h pilot on non-critical tenants. Observability: dashboards added and alerts configured for probe_failure_rate > 2% and unexpected metric drift. Rollback safety: safety guards include minimum traffic thresholds, cooldown windows, and human-in-the-loop requirements for high-impact rollouts. See linked Linear tickets for the followups and opt-in config for the probing evaluator.

review_conversation: Saanvi Patel (reviewer): Can you clarify how the probe evaluator obtains golden prompts for customer workloads? We should avoid shipping any PII-sensitive test sets.

Miguel Rivera (author): The evaluator defaults to an internal golden set maintained by QA; customers can opt-in to use their own private prompt sets via config. We'll add clearer docs and a note about PII handling.

Daniel Cho (reviewer): The hysteresis window looks reasonable, but can we make the default thresholds conservative? Suggest setting default composite_quality_drop to 10% and require >=2 metrics to breach before rollback.
Miguel Rivera (author): Agreed, updated defaults and added feature flag to tighten thresholds for infra canaries.
Ava Thompson (approver): Ran the staged e2e and sanity-checked metrics. Approving pending minor doc clarifications.
CI Bot: e2e integration flaky on first run, reran and all checks passed.
release_notes: Add staged-shadow probing and autorollback enhancements: staged shadow lifecycle, probing sampler, composite metric rollback rules, and observability for rollout health. Backwards compatible; new fields are optional.
notes: This PR is part of a larger rollout safety initiative (ENG-1142) and is safe-guarded behind feature flags. Follow-ups: add golden prompt management UI, expose probe metrics in Console, and add tenant-level rollout policies.
